title: HtmlBdi
responsibility: Renders the native bdi element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlBdi.attributes
inputs.description: Native bdi attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlBdi.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native bdi element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlBdi
outputs.description: The actual native bdi element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
